access_rule: Readable ONLY by pipeline/analysis/confirmatory.py, executed after a pre-registration for the hypothesis has been committed to git. Generation-zone agents must never read this file. As of the endpoint-definitions split there is NO sanctioned exception: the gate reads endpoint definitions from pipeline/data/endpoint_definitions.json, which holds no values.
description: Definitions of outcome fields and the partition gating state. Patient-level outcome VALUES are not stored in this repository; this manifest points at them and records which slices have been unlocked, by which prereg, and when.

exploration.purpose: Never used for confirmatory testing. Reserved for future methods work; outcomes here are still gated.

test.purpose: Primary confirmatory partition. Unlocked slice-by-slice by committed pre-registrations.
test.data_pointer: EXTERNAL — configure via PIPELINE_LOCKED_DATA_PATH; no patient data is committed to this repository.

temporal_holdout.purpose: External replication. Patients with first_contact_year >= holdout_cutoff_year. Opened only after a hypothesis has a completed confirmatory result on the test partition.

unlock_log_note: Append-only. Each entry: {hypothesis_id, prereg_file, prereg_commit_sha, partition, endpoint_id, unlocked_utc, unlocked_by}. Written by /preregister after the prereg commit succeeds, never before.
